paragraph: [In 2024 the government's strategic plan for universal identity cards put holders of the Bilhete de Identidade at 14.8 million of 35.1 million Angolans](<https://www.novojornal.co.ao/sociedade/detalhe/governo-estima-que-dos-351-milhoes-de-angolanos-actuais-apenas-148-milhoes-possuem-bilhete-de-identidade-63150.html>). That is about 42%. [In September 2025 the Secretary of State for Justice, Osvaldo Amaro, said 16,297,777 citizens held the card](<https://angop.ao/noticias/sociedade/cerca-de-16-milhoes-de-angolanos-possuem-bilhete-de-identidade/>), a little under half of about 35 million people. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population holding a national ID. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In June 2024 the World Bank said about 99 percent of Beninese citizens held a legal and digital identity](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202406/wuri-digital-id-project-improving-access-to-public-services-in-benin>). In the last twelve months, the World Bank said in May 2026 that [nearly 99% of the population was biometrically enrolled](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2026/05/20/transforming-lives-in-benin-a-unique-identification-system>). In October 2026 [a Benin official put the share with a digital identity above 99%](<https://transcontinents.africa/fr/article/e-gouvernance-le-benin-et-la-mauritanie-a-lecole-estonienne>). Shares of 98 to 99% are given, and no count of 99.9% has been found since October 2023. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In October 2024 ONECI's deputy director general said only 8 million of 29 million inhabitants were in ONECI's base](<https://www.fratmat.info/article/1974954/politique/cni-double-identite-enregistrement-des-naissances-nni-les-clarifications-du-dga-de-lonceci-pelagie-gonto>). In the last twelve months, [ONECI's director general said in July 2026 that 11 million people held the national identification number](<https://digitalmag.ci/identite-numerique-la-cote-divoire-pays-connecte-mais-pas-encore-pleinement-identifie/>). That is about a third of a population of 32.7 million. No later count has been found. No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population holding a national ID. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In September 2026 Veille Citoyenne pour la Bonne Gouvernance said the President was still the only Congolese publicly issued the national ID card](<https://lumiernews.net/carte-didentite-nationale-en-rdc-ou-en-est-le-projet-trois-ans-apres-la-premiere-carte-remise-a-felix-tshisekedi/>). It gave no count of people enrolled, and no other count has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In October 2024 the programme office said close to 10 million people had received Fayda cards](<https://www.thereporterethiopia.com/42222/>). In the last twelve months, the programme's executive director said in March 2026 that [more than 37 million people were enrolled in Fayda](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202603/ethiopias-digital-id-joins-sovereign-wealth-fund-as-weekly-enrollments-reach-1m>). [Enrolments reached 49.1 million by 24 August 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/fayda-digital-id-nears-50m-enrollments-as-adoption-reshapes-ethiopias-economy>), and [by 9 October 2026 registrations had passed 52 million](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202610/ethiopia-launches-developer-sandbox-to-support-fayda-digital-id-innovation-integration>). Against a population of 135.5 million, that is about 38%. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In June 2026 the Interior Minister told the National Assembly that 335,384 people had enrolled in the electronic identity card campaign since 2024](<https://africacoeurnews.com/2026/06/03/gabon-17720-cartes-didentite-electroniques-toujours-non-retirees/>). That is about 13% of a population of 2.6 million. No other count has been found, and holders of the older card are not counted. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In March 2024 the NIA's Executive Director said 17.8 million Ghanaians were on the National Identification Register](<https://gna.org.gh/2024/03/dr-bawumia-launches-ghana-card-number-at-birth-to-enhance-public-services/>). That is about half of a population of 35.1 million. In the last twelve months, [National Identification Authority data at 30 October 2026 showed 20,610,948 people enrolled for the Ghana Card](<https://ghana.dubawa.org/false-91-of-ghanaians-have-not-received-their-ghana-cards/>), as Dubawa reports. The Ghana Statistical Service projects a population of 34,378,768 for 2026, so about 60% are enrolled. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In July 2025 the Interior Ministry said 9,010,191 people were on the RNPP, after 111,319 duplicates were removed](<https://mediaguinee.com/2025/07/ibrahima-kalil-conde-matd-ce-processus-de-constitution-du-rnpp-et-du-fichier-electoral-va-permettre-a-la-guinee-de-tourner-definitivement-la-page-des-contestations/>). That is about 60% of a population of 15.1 million. No other count has been found. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 counts the people holding a national ID. The only count, from February 2023, is older than three years. No change has been found in the last twelve months, and no other source on this has been found. Absent would need a source from the past three years that counts fewer than a third of the population holding a national ID.

[By December 2024 it had enrolled 740,000, about 13% of 5.7 million](<https://frontpageafricaonline.com/news/liberia-national-identification-registry-drives-digital-transformation-with-strategic-partnerships-and-enrollment-growth/>), the registry said. [At a June 2025 briefing the registry gave about 759,000 enrolled, about 14 percent](<https://newrepubliclib.com/concerns-mount-over-nir-us52m-biometric-id-concession-jeopardizing-jobs-data-and-revenue-security/>). In the last twelve months, [a September 2026 proclamation counted about 720,000 enrolled, near 12.6% of the population](<https://www.africa-newsroom.com/press/liberia-president-boakai-declares-wednesday-september-16-as-national-identification-day?lang=en>). In November 2026 the registry's executive director [told a House committee it held about 740,000 records, with about 5.3 million people still to enrol](<https://www.newerainquirer.com/article/29a1a5b7-1ba2-4dde-a435-3dae7102b0f6>). Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[A government deck shown at ID4Africa in 2025 puts national ID coverage at 90%](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P3-S2-4-Lesotho_FINAL.pdf>). The deck is undated and gives no base, so the figure may be a share of those eligible rather than of the population. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In February 2025 the national police spokesperson said 32 million electronic identity cards had been issued since 2008](<https://www.alhadathlifriqui.com/?p=72708>). He put the share of citizens identified at 87%. [A May 2025 ID4Africa presentation counted 31 million citizens holding the card, out of 36.6 million people](<https://www.id4africa.com/2025/files/T3-P1-S3-MOSIP-Final.pdf>), about 85% of the population. No change has been found in the last twelve months. No source found since October 2023 counts 99.9% of the population holding a national ID. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In October 2023 the World Bank put holders of the new ID number at 0.01% of the population, against a 50% target](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099122123130031407/pdf/P1694131558e640e51a145152595653587b.pdf>). In the last twelve months, [the World Bank said over 3.25 million adults were enrolled by 10 June 2026](<https://www.worldbank.org/en/news/feature/2026/07/01/no-longer-invisible-unlocking-legal-identity-for-millions-in-madagascar>). [Authorities put enrolment above six million by June 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202609/madagascar-strengthens-trust-architecture-for-national-digital-id>). [In September 2026 the interior minister said nearly 5 million were enrolled in the first phase of Izaho tokana](<https://www.2424.mg/identite-numerique-izaho-tokana-2-0-cible-plus-de-10-millions-de-citoyens-pour-sa-deuxieme-phase/>), about 15% of 32.7 million. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In May 2025 the ANRPTS director said more than 94 percent of the population had enrolled since the new system of 2020](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202505/african-nations-making-digital-id-gains-in-the-face-of-common-challenges>). In the last twelve months, the interior minister spoke to the National Assembly in June 2026. He said [the national population register had grown from 3.4 million people in 2019 to over 5.1 million](<https://kassataya.com/ministre-de-linterieur-lenrolement-de-la-population-est-devenu-un-service-public-permanent-qui-garantit-le-droit-de-tous-les-citoyens-a-lenregistrement/>). That is about 96% of a population of 5.3 million. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In September 2026 the ICT Minister said over 13.5 million people were registered in the national ID system](<https://mwnation.com/national-ids-to-last-a-lifetime/>). [He put that at about 99 percent of citizens aged 16 and above](<https://malawi24.com/2026/09/26/nzika-wallet-controversy-who-holds-the-keys-to-malawis-multibillion-digital-identity/>). Against a population of 22.2 million, that is about 61% of people of all ages. No change has been found in the last twelve months. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[On 7 October 2026, in Niamey, the director general of territorial administration said fewer than 3 million people held a national identity card](<https://www.lesahel.org/sensibilisation-en-matiere-de-letat-civil-et-didentification-des-personnes-la-caravane-nationale-fait-halte-a-niamey-pour-cloturer-sa-campagne/>). [He gave the same figure of about three million holders at Diffa in September 2026](<https://anp.ne/diffa-lancement-de-la-tournee-nationale-de-sensibilisation-sur-la-modernisation-de-letat-civil-et-lidentification/>), about 11% of 27.9 million. In the last twelve months, the reports have disagreed. [A week before Diffa, at Agadez, he was reported as saying 3 million of the 13 million lacked one](<https://interieur.gouv.ne/agadez-ouverture-de-la-4eme-etape-de-la-tournee-nationale-de-sensibilisation-sur-les-reformes-en-matiere-detat-civil-et-didentification-des-personnes/>), which would give about 36%. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In January 2025 NIMC's Director General said the biometrics of more than 115 million Nigerians had been captured](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202501/nigeria-launching-multiuse-biometric-id-card-to-drive-economic-financial-inclusion>). In the last twelve months, [NIMC counted about 127 million registered by the close of 2025](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202602/nigeria-launches-nationwide-drive-to-boost-digital-id-coverage-improve-inclusion>). [In September 2026 NIMC put registrations at 142 million](<https://techcabal.com/2026/10/14/nimc-identity-database-locally-hosted/>), about 60% of a population of 237.5 million. [A World Bank report counted 117.5 million numbers issued at 30 June 2026](<https://techcabal.com/2026/09/07/nigeria-needs-62-5-million-nins-in-six-months-to-meet-target/>). Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In September 2026 NIDA said more than 10 million had had biometrics captured, in 27 of 30 districts](<https://umunota.com/en/over-10-million-rwandans-registered-for-digital-id/>). That is about 68% of a population of 14.6 million. In the last twelve months the count rose. [In February 2026 the ICT minister told the Senate over 1.8 million people had given biometrics for the new digital ID, against a target of 15 million](<https://www.parliament.gov.rw/news-detail?cHash=349550b59d9f16c1cdbfe62d270d5c3c&tx_news_pi1%5Baction%5D=detail&tx_news_pi1%5Bcontroller%5D=News&tx_news_pi1%5Bnews%5D=58639>). [NIDA counted more than 8 million registered by August 2026](<https://www.newtimes.co.rw/article/38236/news/rwanda/enrollment-for-digital-id-surpasses-8-million---nida>). Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

No stage is set. Nothing found since October 2023 counts the people holding a national ID. The only count, from 2018, is older than three years. No change has been found in the last twelve months, and no other source on this has been found. Absent would need a source from the past three years that counts fewer than a third of the population holding a national ID.

[In April 2024 the NCRA said over 90 percent of the population was registered for the digital ID](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202404/sierra-leone-putting-digital-id-at-the-center-of-its-digital-transformation-agenda>). In the last twelve months, [a World Bank blog in December 2025 counted 6.4 million people holding a national ID number](<https://blogs.worldbank.org/en/africacan/unlocking-opportunity-how-digital-id-can-transform-lives-in-sierra-leone>). [In August 2026 the NCRA's Director-General put registration at about 93 per cent of the population](<https://sierraloaded.sl/news/ncra-urges-identity-approach-sierra-leones/>). That is about 8.2 million of 8.8 million people. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In November 2025 NIRA's director general said at least one million citizens were enrolled for the national ID](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202511/somalia-to-integrate-more-govt-services-with-national-id-as-issuance-reaches-1m>). [About two million had registered by April 2026, against a target of 15 million by 2029](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2026/Apr/204974/somalias_eaqoonsi_app_shows_progress_gaps_in_digital_public_infrastructure_dpi_push.aspx>). [In September 2026 NIRA said it had registered more than 1.5 million citizens since 2023](<https://www.hiiraan.com/news4/2026/Sep/206316/somalia_registers_15_million_citizens_under_national_id_system.aspx>), about 8% of 19.7 million. In the last twelve months the counts given range from 1.5 million to about 2 million. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In December 2025 Hold the Child put holders of a Nationality Certificate at about 10% of some 12 million people](<https://statelessnessalliance.org/online-marketplace/strengthening-civil-registration-and-ending-statelessness-in-south-sudan>). The group said [national ID cards had yet to be issued at scale](<https://statelessnessalliance.org/online-marketplace/strengthening-civil-registration-and-ending-statelessness-in-south-sudan>). In the last twelve months, a July 2026 World Bank report was cited by the Sudan Independent. It said [nearly 90% of the population lacked government-recognised identification of any kind](<https://www.sudanindependent.net/news/politics/2026/10/12/NEC-turns-to-chiefs-to-verify->). Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.

[More than 6 million Togolese held a unique identification number at the end of 2025, official figures show](<https://www.togofirst.com/fr/services/2304-18802-togo-plus-de-6-millions-de-citoyens-disposent-d-un-niu-a-fin-2025>). In the last twelve months, [in September 2026 ANID counted more than six million people in the e-ID Togo register](<https://levisionnaire.tg/e-id-togo-plus-de-6-millions-de-personnes-enregistrees-la-region-de-la-kara-prochaine-etape/>). That is about 70% of a population of 8.6 million. [In March 2026 the World Bank counted nearly 4 million people enrolled in the mass registration campaign](<https://documents1.worldbank.org/curated/en/099032526174532318/pdf/P169594-5fd6786a-2b45-425b-95b6-0e79d792a6fb.pdf>). That is 49% of the population. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[An FSDT analysis counted over 22 million Tanzanians holding a National Identification Number in April 2026](<https://www.biometricupdate.com/202608/tanzania-pushes-crvs-id-integration-as-birth-registration-becomes-a-dpi-layer>). In the last twelve months, [NIDA reported 27.1 million adults registered in May 2026, 87% of adults](<https://id4africa.com/2026/files/T1-3-4-Tanzania-FINAL.pdf>), with children not yet enrolled. [In September 2026 the Home Affairs Minister said 27,520,835 people were registered and 23,515,667 had received a number](<https://www.mwananchi.co.tz/mw/habari/kitaifa/nida-yaondoa-kikwazo-cha-umri-namba-kuunganisha-huduma-za-kiraia-5597344>). The registered count is about 39% of a population of 70.5 million. Establishing would need a source from the past three years that counts two-thirds of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In January 2026 NIRA said 28.5 million people were registered under the old system](<https://www.monitor.co.ug/uganda/news/national/21-million-ugandans-transferred-to-new-nira-system-as-registration-drive-intensifies-5318862>). It said 21.4 million had been moved to the new one. In the last twelve months, the Prime Minister said in August 2026 that [11.9 million Ugandans were not registered](<https://www.parliament.go.ug/news/4571/new-id-system-faces-questions-over-digital-verification>). At NIRA's September 2026 expo, [figures cited by the minister put about 36.2 million Ugandans identified](<https://nilepost.co.ug/news/374307/identity-is-the-foundation-of-security-development-says-minister-kamuntu-as-nira-expo-opens>). That is about 78.8% of the population. Operating would need a source from the past three years that counts 99.9% of the population or more holding a national ID.

[In September 2024 UNDP said INRIS had enrolled 1.5 million people with biometrics](<https://www.undp.org/digital/blog/dpi-safeguards-come-online-zambias-next-phase-digital-integration>). [A September 2025 World Bank appraisal put biometric registration at 15 percent of adults](<https://documents.worldbank.org/en/publication/documents-reports/documentdetail/099100625152522349>). In the last twelve months, [in July 2026 ITWeb, citing UNDP, still gave about 1.5 million enrolled in a population of around 20 million](<https://www.itweb.co.za/article/from-rails-to-routine/dgp45vaB8nQ7X9l8>). That is under 8% of the whole population. Preparing would need a source from the past three years that counts a third of the population or more holding a national ID.
